sources.title: SRA: Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce SRA (Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation), a novel frame-work that reframes CTKD through the physical lens of Multi-Particle Dynamical Systems. SRA shifts the fundamental unit of alignment from tokens to robust, tokenizer-agnostic spans.
